description: Use this when someone asks to add a new client to a salon. Returns the client's id, name, salon and language; the phone and email given are saved but never returned. Not for changing an existing client.

language.description: Language for their messages, as a code such as en, it or pt-BR. Defaults to the salon language.

phone.description: Mobile number, with the country code when known.

requestId.description: A unique id you choose for this client, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same requestId returns the first client instead of adding a second one.

salonId.description: Id of the salon, from list_salons. Leave it out when the user has one salon.

name: create_client
title: Add a salon client
